predicate.label: has spokesperson
predicate.definition: Organization or principal X has person Y serving as its spokesperson.
ambiguous: dateline/location replacing the principal or person
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: inverse spokesperson_for with correct attachment; organization-modifying spokesman and appositive person. Excludes: leader/president/lawyer/secretary alone; speaking at a building; spokesperson-to-principal forward direction. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: dateline/location replacing the principal or person.

rationale: Spokesperson/speech-at-office is the clearest identified directional family, amid opaque Bell-company descriptions and business ventures. Select principal-to-spokesperson without inventing a generic Bell affiliation predicate; bare saying at an office still needs role evidence.
